lines.text: Check which assets follow a beneficiary designation, which may enter your estate, and when spouse rights or conflicting paperwork need advice.

items.text: List current and former employers' retirement plans, personal retirement accounts and insurance policies.
Ask each provider for the primary and contingent beneficiaries currently accepted on file.
Ask what happens if a beneficiary has died, cannot be found or is not eligible.
Check consent, signature and submission requirements before making a change.
Submit through the official process and retain acceptance confirmation.
Record the check date and where confirmation is stored; set a review after significant life changes.

line.text: Who is named on the forms that override a will is one of the first things it raises, because it is the one most often years out of date.
